tooling: rclone webdav against /remote.php/webdav/, which answers 401 with a Basic realm of 'Shadow Drive'. Standard Nextcloud clients
chaining: The cheapest Enterprise-build Nextcloud in Europe at EUR 2.99 for 200 GB, so it is a candidate small shard. The 20 GB per-file cap is uniform across tiers and does not scale, which stops it being an archive target

binding_note: The free 20 GB is an order of magnitude under the 500 GB filter, and the paid tiers carry a 20 GB per-file cap that does not move with the plan. Either number alone stops it; the cap is the one that would still bind at 2 TB.
confidence_note: What would raise it is a live re-read of the offers page, because this provider has already moved its price once.
notes: The free 20 GB is real and it is the same Enterprise build as the paid tiers, so it works as a cheap test endpoint. It fails as capacity on size, and it fails on a per-file cap that never improves.
